pages.title: Slate Ossuary
pages.notes: The portal block leading into the next Simulation require an item called $(item)Bones of the Damned$(). It's made in the $(item)Slate Ossuary$().$(br2)The required materials can be seen in $(l:portal_hub/4_schematica)Schematica$(). Above is a list of some key items required.

pages.text: The $(item)Slate Ossuary$() can make the first four tiers of $(item)Blood Magic$() slates using only $(item)LP$() from your blood network. (Even the fifth tier once you have an $(item)Archmage Blood Orb$()).$(br2)This is a great alternative to crafting slates in the $(item)Blood Altar$().$(br2)It requires less LP to produce each slate, and although it cannot be upgraded with $(item)Speed Runes$(), the $(item)Slate Ossuary$() default speed is nothing to scoff at.
